Title: Fibroid Risk Isn't Just Genetics - What Actually Raises It

Description:
Most people chalk up heavy periods and pelvic pressure up to stress or "just genetics," but research points to a few everyday habits instead - a diet heavy in red meat, regular alcohol use, and low vitamin D are all linked to higher fibroid risk. Swapping in more fish and vegetables, cutting back on alcohol, and closing your vitamin D gap may help lower that risk.
